paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
notes: First storage-ring ALP search using a polarized deuteron beam at COSY. The paper sets an upper limit on the oscillating EDM component of the deuteron (AxionEDM) and ALP coupling constants in the axion mass range ~4.95-5.02 neV/c^2 (around spin precession frequency 121 kHz). However, the provided paper content cuts off before the Section IV results tables/figures with the numerical EDM and coupling limits, so no specific (mass, coupling) data points could be extracted. The dominant scan range is m_a ~ 4.95e-9 to 5.02e-9 eV. Local DM density would be assumed (~0.4 GeV/cm^3) but the value is not stated in the available text. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionEDM (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
